panel-4.notes: Plate 4: four-province net debt-to-GDP from most-recent budgets. ON: 37.7% (Fall Economic Outlook Nov 2025); QC: 38.8% (Budget 2026-2027, March 18 2026 -- Tier A verified); AB: 10.5% (Budget 2026, Feb 26 2026); BC: 30.6% taxpayer-supported basis (Budget 2026, Feb 17 2026). Publisher's-own basis per Bartlett/IFSD recommendation; each bar annotated with vintage stamp and basis badge. Source card: plate-4.yaml (Tier B, user_confirmed_at pending). Emitted by pipeline.build.derive_fiscal_provincial_debt().

_meta.description: Four-province net debt-to-GDP from most-recent provincial budgets: ON / QC / AB / BC.
_meta.units: percent of GDP (provincial); BC on taxpayer-supported basis (different denominator — see methodology_note)
_meta.vintage_note: Mixed vintage: ON Nov 2025, QC March 2026 (Budget 2026-2027), AB Feb 2026, BC Feb 2026.
_meta.methodology_note: Publisher's-own basis per Bartlett/IFSD recommendation. BC publishes 'taxpayer-supported debt-to-GDP' not 'net debt-to-GDP' -- these are different denominators (net debt includes financial-assets netting; taxpayer-supported excludes self-supported Crown corporation debt). BC bar must carry footnote 'taxpayer-supported basis' in chart annotation. ON, QC, AB are net-debt-to-GDP. Cross-province comparison is approximate; methodology gap must appear in blurb or footnote.
_meta.chart_note: Each bar should carry: province label, value, vintage stamp (e.g. 'as of Nov 2025'), and methodology badge for BC.

provinces.vintage: Ontario Fall Economic Outlook and Fiscal Review 2025 (November 2025)
provinces.notes: Projected for FY2025-26. Government target is below 40.0%. Next: Budget 2026 (expected March-April 2026).

38.8% confirmed primary-verified Tier A from Quebec Budget 2026-2027 tabled March 18 2026. Previous card vintage (Budget 2025-2026, March 2025) superseded. Government medium-term target: 35.5% by 2032-33, 32.5% by 2037-38.
Turns positive (net debt) at 10.5% in FY2026-27, rising to ~13% by FY2028-29. Outside the pandemic, these would be the highest levels in 30 years (per Alberta Budget 2026).

BC publishes taxpayer-supported debt (excludes self-supported Crown corporation debt), not net-debt-to-GDP. Value 30.6% in 2026-27, rising to 34.4% in 2027-28 and 37.4% in 2028-29. Chart must annotate as taxpayer-supported basis. RESEARCHER: check if BC Budget 2026 backgrounder PDF publishes net-debt-to-GDP separately.
